data.body:
Scheduled run 42572022074 (2026-11-08 22:16 PST, head 0f409b946e4) concluded failure, so the AC is NOT met yet. The langfuse job never reached docker compose up: it failed earlier in setup-uv, so the MinIO image fix (Gerrit 3278) is still unexercised. Distinct causes found:
1. setup-uv: 5 jobs (langfuse, jira DC smoke, Pandoc ubuntu, Pandoc macos, live bedrock) got 504 Gateway Time-out from github.com/astral-sh/uv/releases/download at the action's single Invoke-WebRequest, during GitHub's 2026-11-09 incident 'Increased timeouts due to surge in anonymous users'. 4 other jobs fetched the same asset in the same minute. Not caused by Gerrit 3291: the 2026-11-02 run already installed uv 0.13.6 through this action without error. Filed + fixing as sad-convective-bagworm (bounded retry).
2. live bedrock 'Summarize LLM token usage' (No module named 'rebar'): runs under if: always() after setup-uv failed, so the package was never installed. Same cause as 1; no separate change.
3. live openai: 2 plan-review tests got HTTP 400 invalid_prompt (OpenAI usage-policy flag) on one agentic plan-reviewer call each; review degraded to INDETERMINATE. Passed on 2026-11-01. Not reproducible locally (operator-host OpenAI key has no credit). Filed as deceptive-banal-baboon.
Next: land the setup-uv fix, then dispatch the workflow on main to exercise the langfuse/MinIO path.
